   This descriptor reflects the complexity and the distribution of atoms around the outer parts of the molecule. Thus, a positive impact means molecules with higher peripheral complexity tend to have better predicted properties.

   Phi is related to the molecular shape and branching. It captures geometric aspects such as linearity versus globularity.
